question: Calculate the average home team goal in the 2010/2011 season in the country of Poland.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "matches_with_league" AS SELECT t2.season, t2.home_team_goal, t3.name AS league_name FROM table_2 AS t2 JOIN table_3 AS t3 ON t2.league_id = t3.id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH info AS (
  SELECT name, type
  FROM pragma_table_info('table_2')
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT name, type
  FROM info
  WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%goal%' OR lower(name) IN ('season','league_id','home_team_api_id','away_team_api_id')
)
SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY name;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "matches_with_league" AS SELECT t2.season, CAST(COALESCE(regexp_extract(t2.goal, '"home"\s*:\s*(\d+)', 1), regexp_extract(t2.goal, '^(\d+)', 1)) AS INTEGER) AS home_team_goal, t3.name AS league_name FROM table_2 AS t2 JOIN table_3 AS t3 ON t2.league_id = t3.id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT ROUND(AVG(home_team_goal), 3) AS avg_home_team_goals
FROM matches_with_league
WHERE season = '2010/2011'
  AND LOWER(league_name) LIKE '%poland%';
